The repo has 7 workspace packages. I only checked `@relayed/*` dependencies declared in each `package.json`, not what the code actually imports.

| Package | Path | `@relayed/*` dependencies |
|---|---|---|
| `@relayed/desktop` | `apps/desktop` | authz, icons, protocol, telemetry |
| `@relayed/server` | `apps/server` | authz, protocol, telemetry |
| `@relayed/agent` | `apps/agent` | none |
| `@relayed/authz` | `packages/authz` | none |
| `@relayed/icons` | `packages/icons` | none |
| `@relayed/protocol` | `packages/protocol` | none |
| `@relayed/telemetry` | `packages/telemetry` | none |

All internal dependencies use `workspace:*`. Only the two apps depend on other workspace packages: none of the shared packages depend on each other, and `apps/agent` depends on none of them. `@relayed/icons` is used only by desktop (`apps/desktop/package.json:17`).
